source.title: Titanium Powder — original globalmenace Retail 12.0.5 report (Wowhead comments indexed on PTR page)
source.author: globalmenace

quote: Today (WoW Retail 12.0.5) I prospected 1000 Titanium Ore.
notes: Firsthand commenter explicitly identifies Retail 12.0.5, 1,000 Titanium Ore processed and 143 Titanium Powder obtained. The 200 five-ore equivalents are nominal, not independently logged completed casts. Source also lists 18 gem unit counts without material names, so none are assigned output IDs or recorded as named drops. The page is a PTR URL mirror of a comment claiming a Retail study, not evidence the study ran on PTR. Comment's 'Today' lacks a verifiable calendar date. No hit counts, zero outcomes, per-cast histograms, skill, specialization, refunds or prices recorded. Do not confuse 143/1000 ore with P(hit) per cast.
